# SEO/GEO Operator — Regole e workflow

Load with the current client handoff/memory before any content or CMS work.

## A. Regole d'oro
1. Verify live or it did not happen (cache-bust fetch + expected counts + real JSON schema parse).
2. Positions only if confirmed by ≥2 real GSC clicks.
3. Never default author — set correct author at create and re-check before done.
4. Double anti-cannibalization before new pages: GSC by Page + CMS slug `status=any`. Hit → strengthen existing.
5. Fact-check every number/year/citation before publish; unverifiable in 5 min → generalize or cut.
6. No publish / staging→prod sync / email send without the owner's explicit go.
7. JSON-LD always one-line minified (wpautop). Shopify strips body scripts — schema via app/theme.
8. Never year in slug (title only). Shopify article renames need manual redirects.
9. One owner correction = permanent rule in memory.
10. Update memory/changelog every session.

## B. New content workflow
1. Load content skill BEFORE writing.
2. Cannibalization check → SERP info-gain → fact-check → draft structure (varied openings, original table, uncertainty section, FAQ+schema, 6+ verified internal links).
3. Author explicit; language correct; draft → owner review → publish → live checklist.

## C. Quick-win ROI order
Internal links missing → broken links → thin real wordcount → invisible structural fixes → expand ranked pages → verified gaps only.

## E. Client reports
White-label 9-slide deck + email; click-confirmed positions only; "Buonasera"; drafts via tools, the owner sends.

name: SEO/GEO Content
description: >-
  Use before writing or expanding any client article — GEO citability,
  anti-template, cannibalization, fact-check.
---
# SEO/GEO Content (universal)

Load before writing or expanding any client page. The weekly WP protocol is NOT in this skill — only the transferable rules.

## Philosophy
Twin goal: Google rank + LLM citability (AIO, ChatGPT, Perplexity). Citability, extractability, authority, freshness, consensus alignment. Never fabricate stats. Unverifiable in 5 min → qualitative language or cut.

## Anti-template (post-HCU, overrides any fixed layout)
Required coverage (answer-first, extractable, FAQ, sources) — presentation MUST vary on the same site.
- Vary the opening (QA box is one option, not the law). Direct answer in the first chunk, container can change.
- ≥2 information-gain points absent from top-3 competitors. Citations alone ≠ originality.
- Product/CTA after context, with when-NOT-to-use. Own-product: italic disclosure.
- Skip the same visual every time. Break ≥2 old-template elements per new piece; tell the owner what you broke.
- YMYL: add an honest-uncertainty section.

## Red lines
- No fake authors, credentials, years of experience, or invented experts.
- Certs/seals/awards attach to the EXACT product that earned them (never "the line").
- Own products: transparent, never fake-neutral discovery, never trash an ingredient the client sells.
- Proprietary original is the tiebreaker AFTER matching live AI-answer consensus (entities, structure, format).

## Before ANY new URL
1. Target keyword, intent, audience, existing content, commercial relationship.
2. Cannibalization twice: `site:domain keyword` + CMS status=any + GSC by page (a dest page may already rank for "cost").
3. Two pages on the same topic ≠ auto-merge if each variant has its own volume — differentiate and cross-link.
4. Collect 8+ real internal URLs and 2-3 authoritative externals (not competitors) before writing. 6-10 real internal links in the piece. Zero placeholders.

## Refresh > new (default this month)
Half of SEO/GEO is improving what already ranks.
- Read the actual content, never trust the slug.
- Ask before editing sponsored posts.
- Replacement beats append; density beats length.
- If you find one template bug, scan the whole category (CMS search is unreliable — fetch raw and regex).
- After edit: verify via API `content.raw`, author byline survived, forbidden-terms regex. Live cache can lie.

## Draft / publish
Client work = draft for the owner. No publish, staging→prod sync, or client email without explicit go. Verify live or it did not happen.

## GEO coverage (form varies)
Author + dates; answer-first first chunk; FAQ 5-10; comparison table if evaluation; steps if how-to; Fonti when citing science; schema matching the CMS plugin (Rank Math FAQ blocks only if Rank Math is actually installed).

  Use when drafting X replies to SEO/GEO posts so they add real operator
  information gain.
---
# X reply drafts for SEO/GEO

Use this when drafting the owner's replies on X.

## Bar
Only draft if the reply adds information gain the original post did not contain:
- a mechanism (retrieval vs ranking vs recommendation)
- a surface constraint (Google AIO vs ChatGPT free vs paid)
- a counterexample
- a measurement implication (what GSC can/can't show)

If you only agree in different words, do not draft.

## Voice
Short. Contractions. No em dashes. No slogans. Sounds like a practitioner in the thread.

## Never
- Name Ahrefs (or Semrush as the hero)
- Fake client metrics
- "Great point" / restating the OP

## Delivery
Each reply is its own message with the tweet URL.

name: Rankdelta AI visibility report
description: >-
  Use when someone says yes to an AI visibility report: build a real-data
  Rankdelta.ai report page, then draft the delivery email.
---
# Report visibilita AI (Rankdelta)

Generate a public report from **Rankdelta data only**. Never invent numbers. Never use Ahrefs.

## Data
Pull numbers from the connected Rankdelta.ai MCP (legacy name: AstroSEO) plus an AI visibility check. Do not use the Site Explorer browser unless a metric is truly missing from the MCP.

## Branding (customer-facing)
- Every metric on the page is **Rankdelta.ai** (e.g. Domain Rank / Authority via **Rankdelta.ai -- Site Explorer**).
- Never name **DataForSEO**, Ahrefs, or other raw vendors on the report page, even when the MCP note says the rank scale is DataForSEO 0-1000. That is internal plumbing; the product metric is proprietary Rankdelta.
- Source lines: `Fonte: Rankdelta.ai -- Site Explorer, {month year}` -- not "via DataForSEO".

## Delivery email
Consultant Italian. Complete short paragraphs. Show the owner the draft before send.

Ciao {Name},

come promesso, ti mando il report che abbiamo preparato sulla visibilita nei motori di ricerca AI di {Brand}.

{report URL}

{One sentence: buyer query + who appears on that question.}

Ti propongo di fissare una call gratuita di 15 minuti con un nostro strategist per discutere alcune implementazioni che potreste fare per migliorare il posizionamento attuale.

Avresti delle disponibilita settimana prossima?

Grazie,

{Full mailbox signature}

- No Domain Rank, backlink counts, or organic visits in the email (those stay on the report page).
- No Calendly unless the owner asks. No price unless the owner asks.
- If they asked to see the query, add one clause that it is on the page.
- Sign as the sales or account manager the owner names.
- Never send a hold. Wait until the live report page has real numbers.

## Rules
1. Real data only. Missing number -> omit the section.
2. Do not overclaim. Never write "0% everywhere" unless measured.
3. Italian market story. If only ChatGPT was measured, say so.
4. Plans start at **EUR 29/mese**. Report CTA may mention EUR 29. **Delivery email: no price** unless the owner asks.
5. Do not send the email until the live title is the report and the owner approved the draft.
6. Prefer a real buyer query for the lead's category (e.g. "migliori X in Italia"), not a vague auto-query that returns tools instead of peers. If the AI visibility check auto-picks a weak query, remeasure with the right question before publishing.
